**\# \*\*Phishing Awareness\*\***  
*\#\# \*What Is Phishing?\**

- Phishing is a type of cyberattack where someone pretends to be a trusted source to trick you into sharing private information like passwords, bank details, or credit card numbers.

*\#\# \*Types of Phishing Scams\**

- Phishing can take a variety of forms such as mass phishing which may come through your email or targeted phishing which makes it look like it comes from someone you know.

## **\# \*\*How to Recognize a Phishing Email\*\***

Phishing scams attempt to steal students’ personal information like emails, passwords, and phone numbers. There are a couple ways to figure out if an email is a scam.
